title: [finding] half-state H31 binds a PR to a card by its `Part of` line, so every correctly-gated epic tracker gets a row telling a seat to hang a gate nothing will clear
body:
## What happens

`check-half-states.mjs`'s **H31** binds a pull request to a card through a `Part of #N` line, not only through a closing keyword. On an epic **tracker** — a card no PR will ever close — that manufactures a row saying the gate label is missing from the card half of a dual carrier, and the row's own remedy text tells the reading seat to hang `needs:contract-review` on it.

Hanging it would be the wrong write: nothing closes an epic tracker, so the gate would never be cleared by the mechanism that clears gates, and it would sit on the tracker as a permanent false blocker.

## Measured, on the 2026-09-14T19:45:00Z sweep of anchor #9857

The row:

> **H31** #14122 — `needs:contract-review` on the delivering open PR #18213 (draft, via a `Part of` declaration), #18212 (draft, via a `Part of` declaration) while the CARD does NOT carry it …

The two PRs' own bodies, read at 2026-09-14T21:1xZ via `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls/{n}`:

| PR | closing keyword | `Part of` line |
|---|---|---|
| #18212 | `Fixes #18202` | `Part of #14122 — the epic tracking the one-artifact/N-packages family. That tracker stays open.` |
| #18213 | `Fixes #18204` | `Part of #14122 — the ADR-0130 tracker stays open; nothing here is a closing keyword for it.` |

And the delivering cards:

- **#18202** carries `needs:contract-review` (labels read 21:0xZ: `bug, priority:p1, pm:dispatched, domain:spec, needs:contract-review`).
- **#18204** carries `needs:contract-review` (labels read 21:0xZ: `bug, priority:p1, pm:dispatched, domain:cli, needs:contract-review`).

⇒ **Both dual carriers are intact.** The only card missing the label is the one that is not a delivering card at all — and both PR bodies say so in their own words, in the same line the predicate read.

## Why this one matters more than an ordinary false positive

H31 is the row family whose stated purpose is that 「闸门被剥不是红灯是放行」 — a stripped gate is a GREEN light, so the row exists to make a missing carrier visible. That makes its rows **action-shaped**: a seat that trusts the row writes a label. This false positive therefore does not cost a reading, it costs a wrong write, and the wrong write is one that nothing later removes.

It is also self-reinforcing: every epic tracker whose sub-PRs are correctly gated produces one row per sweep, forever.

## Suggested direction (not a ruling)

Bind the PR to the card the PR **closes**. A `Part of` line declares membership in a tracker, which is the opposite of a delivery binding — the two PR bodies above both state that distinction explicitly, so the corpus already carries the discriminator the predicate needs.

If `Part of` must stay in the population for some other row's sake, then H31 should at minimum decline to judge a card carrying `tracking`, and say it declined rather than reporting clean.

## Dedupe words

`H31` · `Part of` · `dual carrier` · `needs:contract-review` · `epic tracker`
